messages:
aya: kicking off an ablation + replay run for v3.4-int4. Want a hybrid gate: short canary + replay adversarial fuzz + cohorted A/B for business customers. Goal: catch quant artifacts and calibration drift early.

 tom: nice. what's the core new checks compared to our usual canary?

 aya: three additions: 1) KL divergence between control & treatment avg logits for top-5 tokens per prompt (flag if KL>0.12), 2) entropy shift for generation (delta_entropy>0.08) as a proxy for calibration, 3) adversarial replay slice that mutates prompts (punctuation trimming, squeezed whitespace, token-bucketed accents) to expose quant fragility.

 sven: love the KL/entropy checks. How do those map to rollback? numeric thresholds pls.

 aya: draft thresholds: immediate rollback if MRR_abs_drop >= 0.02 OR halluc_rate_pp increase >0.6pp. Soft-block if KL>0.12 OR entropy_shift>0.08 for more than 2 windows (10m each) -> pause ramp and run targeted replay. If adversarial replay discordance >1.5% -> block promote.

 lexi: also add a calibration plot to the dashboard (predicted token prob vs empirical). If calibration slope deviates >0.1, hold.

 hana: sample-size: we need at least 3k per cohort per window for the KL test to be meaningful. For adversarial replay use 4k mutated prompts.

 aya: ops-friendly YAML snippet below for automation: 

 ```yaml
hybrid_gate:
  canary_steps: [1,5,20]
  check_window: 10m
  metrics:
    - name: mrr_abs_drop
      immediate_rollback: 0.02
    - name: halluc_rate_pp
      immediate_rollback: 0.006
    - name: kl_top5_avg
      soft_block_threshold: 0.12
      consecutive_windows: 2
    - name: entropy_shift
      soft_block_threshold: 0.08
      consecutive_windows: 2
    - name: adversarial_replay_discord
      block_threshold: 0.015
  cohorts:
    - default
    - business
  cohorts_overrides:
    business:
      fidelity_rel_threshold: -0.005
      kv_warmup_min: 0.97
  flapping_cooldown: 120m
  post_rollback_hold: 6h
```

 tom: minor clarifying q: is KL computed on logit vectors before softmax? we should standardize.

 aya: yes, pre-softmax logits averaged per token position, top-5 tokens distribution. I'll include the diag function in the bundle.

 sven: add tokens-per-response cost guard: >+12% flags manual review. Also suggest tagging model as "quant-lite" in rollout to enable transparent diagnostics.

 deploy-bot: Canary started for v3.4-int4 run r-2026032806; initial 1% traffic.

 lexi: ops ask: surface KL and entropy time-series on the canary board and include replay diff link in rollback button payload.

 omar: I'll wire the replay harness and adversarial mutator. Will post the mutated prompt sample set and a short diff table when run completes.

 aya: thanks all. aim is cautious bring-up: conservative auto-fallbacks and an adversarial replay to catch subtle quant regressions. Post results here with per-cohort KL/entropy and top discordant prompts. :wave:
